description: This file defines the internal class 'SiloManifestProvider' responsible for creating and providing 'SiloManifest' and related mappings for a Orleans silo. It contains methods to generate grain interface and class manifests based on provided configurations and resolvers.

classes.name: SiloManifestProvider
classes.description: An internal class responsible for creating and providing a silo's grain manifest and type mappings based on configuration options and providers.

methods.name: SiloManifestProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the silo manifest and grain type map using provided providers, options, and resolvers.

methods.name: CreateInterfaceManifest
methods.description: Creates an immutable dictionary mapping GrainInterfaceType to GrainInterfaceProperties based on provided interface property providers and options.

methods.name: CreateGrainManifest
methods.description: Creates grain property and type mappings based on grain class configurations, providers, and resolvers.
